# YesTick AI

> The complete omnichannel inbox and smart chatbot platform.

YesTick AI is a powerful AI productivity platform and AI business automation software. 
It enables organizations to build intelligent AI agents, automate business workflows, and scale their customer engagement without writing a single line of code.

## Key Features
- **Omnichannel Inbox**: Centralize messages from WhatsApp API, FB Messenger, Telegram, Instagram, etc.
- **AI Automation Platform**: Automate business processes and create custom workflow automations.
- **Smart Chatbot**: Provide 24/7 intelligent customer support.
- **Enterprise AI Solutions**: Scalable automation software for businesses of all sizes.
